source: gauntlet/evidence/charger/w2r1/strip.png.json trace + headless state trace of charger id4, charger-swarm seed 1, 400 ticks, no bot, no input
cropBoxNote: The wave-1 box (144,72,192,128) put the charger in the bottom-right corner and cut the lane after the arena was rebuilt by the rooms-as-data work. 184,128,192,128 centres the same subject at the same size and is fixed for every wave-2 round.

tellBudget.note: What the player actually gets to read, all of it inside the 16-tick freeze. Unchanged from wave 1: no sim value moved this round.
tellBudget.directional_warning_note: The amber lane states the direction from freeze tick 1 (200 ms before contact) and re-measures every tick while the sim is still tracking. The red is the commit beat, not the warning: 50 ms of it, and it cannot legally start earlier than chargerLockTick without lying about the aim.

crowd.exhibit-crowd.png: scenario wave3, seed 1, bot kite, tick 341 - all four chargers alive and POSED into freeze at stateTick 3 / 7 / 11 / 14 on the same tick, each aimed at the player. This is the exact frame the wave-1 gap describes ('four identical red blinks with no way to tell which lane each will take'). Four lanes, four lengths, two colours, four directions.
crowd.exhibit-crowd.cmd: pnpm strip -- --scenario wave3 --seed 1 --bot kite --from 340 --frames 1 --zoom 2 --crop 0,0,480,270 --eval "const cs=w().enemies.filter(e=>e.active&&e.kind==='charger'); const tks=[2,6,10,13]; cs.forEach((e,i)=>{ e.state='freeze'; e.stateTick=tks[i%4]; e.vx=0; e.vy=0; e.aimAngle=Math.atan2(p().y-e.y,p().x-e.x) }); g.step(1)"
crowd.exhibit-crowd-wave3-live.png: scenario wave3, seed 1, bot kite, tick 491, NOT posed: charger 5 freeze:14 (locked, red), charger 6 dash:20, charger 7 freeze:1, plus two brutes and a caster bolt. What the density actually looks like in play.
crowd.worstCaseMeasured: wave3 seed 1 with the kite bot never puts three chargers in freeze on the same tick; two is the natural maximum. charger-swarm seeds 1-5, 1200 ticks each, idle player: also never three. So the four-tell frame has to be posed to exist, and exhibit-crowd.png poses it.

scenarioNote: The piece protocol asks for `--scenario charger`. It does not exist in src/sim/scenarios.ts and createWorld falls back to `full`, so every round so far has used `charger-swarm` (four chargers, no waves) for the single-subject strip. `--scenario wave3` does work and is used for both crowd exhibits. src/sim/scenarios.ts is not this lane's file.
